item.title: ZTools updates itself, and browser tools have no limit
item.description: Open tabs now load a new ZTools release by themselves, browser tools need no account and have no usage limit, and one small promotion for another product from the same team.
item.content:encoded:
You had ZTools open in a tab for a week. Until now, that tab could still be running last week's release. That changes today.

Updates reach open tabs​

A small worker now watches for a new release. It caches nothing. When one is out, the page loads it at a safe moment, and anything you've typed stays where it was.

Some releases are required. Then an update screen tells you why and offers one Update button. On Android, a new build comes through Google Play's in-app update, and smaller fixes arrive as signed over-the-air updates. How ZTools stays up to date has the details.

Browser tools: no limit, no account​

Tools that run in your browser have no usage limit, and you don't need an account to use them.

Allowances apply only where the work runs on our side: the AI assistant, Speak, and tools that process files on our server. Each feature shows its daily or monthly allowance beside it, and the amount depends on your plan. The Plans page lists them.

One small promotion​

The dashboard and tool pages now show one small ad, clearly marked. It's always for another product made by the ZTools team, never for ZTools itself. Plans that remove promotions don't show it.

The ZTools team

item.title: What's new in ZTools: tours, a phone app view and plans
item.description: Page tours and a six-step walkthrough, an app view on phones, the Workbench design, and ZTools Pro and Growth Suite plans.
item.content:encoded:
Useful tools. One workbench. This release brings the Workbench design to the web app, an app view on phones, guided tours, and plans you can buy.

Guided tours and a walkthrough​

  • On the home page, Speak, Meeting notes, Plans, the dashboard and account settings, the tour button shows a short tour of that page. The first time you visit one of these pages, a hint says: "Take a quick tour of this page".
  • How ZTools works: six short screens show what ZTools does. Start anywhere.

An app view on phones​

On a phone, home, the dashboard, account settings, sign-in and the first-run screens open as app screens, with a bottom bar for Home, Dashboard, Speak, Plans and Account. Web and Android · Many tools work without signing in.

Plans​

ZTools offers a free plan and paid plans. Each paid plan's price, billing period and allowances are shown on the Plans page before you pay. Payments are processed by Polar. ZTools never receives your card number.

Shared AI​

If Anthropic's shared credit is unavailable, ZTools sends the same request from its server to OpenAI instead, within the same allowance. If neither can answer, AI pauses.

The ZTools team

item.title: Welcome to the ZTools Blog
item.description: This is the first post on the ZTools documentation blog. We'll use this space for:
item.content:encoded:
This is the first post on the ZTools documentation blog. We'll use this space for:

  • Release notes — what's new in each ZTools update
  • Tool spotlights — deep-dives on individual tools and the problems they solve
  • Dev journal — design decisions, technical tradeoffs, occasional mistakes

What's shipped (May 2026)​

  • Tools live at ztools.zaions.com — all browser-only, no signup, no upload
  • First wave of docs — top 20 highest-demand tools documented with use cases, examples, and FAQs (browse them →)
  • GitHub repo for this docs site is open-source: github.com/aoneahsan/ztools-docs
  • Android app shipped on Play Store; iOS pending Apple developer account approval

What's next​

  • 15-20 tools per batch through batch 35+ until every documented tool from the app appears here
  • Long-form how-to guides covering common workflows (compress images, format JSON, generate strong passwords)
  • Algolia DocSearch integration for site-wide search

If there's a tool you'd like documented sooner, open an issue on GitHub and we'll bump it up the queue.

— Ahsan
